sites.title: 观测站
sites.desc: 你现在站的地方。所有子域、项目与实时状态的入口，工作在 Cloudflare 边缘。
sites.desc_en: You are here. The entry point to every subdomain, project and live status, served from the Cloudflare edge.

sites.title: 个人说明书
sites.desc: Cyberpunk 2077 风格的个人主页：属性面板、任务日志、超梦回放。同一份源码构建公开版与内网版。
sites.desc_en: A Cyberpunk 2077 style personal page: stat panels, mission log, braindance replays. One codebase builds the public and private variants.

sites.title: Web 实验室
sites.desc: 六个舱段的实验场：浏览器内训练神经网络、安全工具箱、V8 快照解析、WebUSB 直连安卓跑 ADB、WebRTC 传文件、小品舱。
sites.desc_en: Six bays: train a neural net in the browser, a security toolbox, V8 heap snapshot analysis, WebUSB into real ADB on Android, WebRTC transfer, and an arcade.

sites.title: Mermaid 渲染器
sites.desc: Monaco 编辑 + 实时预览，把文本画成图并导出 PNG / JPG。本地保存草稿，打开即用。
sites.desc_en: Monaco editor with live preview. Turn text into diagrams and export PNG or JPG, with drafts kept locally.

sites.title: 演算台
sites.desc: 把表达式拆开给你看：词法 token 流、AST、求值过程逐步可视化，基于 Jison 手写文法。
sites.desc_en: Take an expression apart: the real token stream, the grammar, the LALR table and the result. Hand-written Jison grammar.

sites.title: 技能包
sites.desc: 给 coding agent 用的技能管理器与技能库：用 package.json 当版本控制，一行命令装到全局。
sites.desc_en: A skill manager and registry for coding agents. package.json as the version control, one command to install globally.

sites.title: 站点状态
sites.desc: 每 15 分钟巡检所有子域的响应码、往返延迟与证书状态，历史曲线公开可查。
sites.desc_en: Checks every subdomain every 15 minutes: status code, latency and TLS. History is public.

sites.title: ClojureScript 自学站
sites.desc: 分十二章的 ClojureScript 中文教程，每段代码都能在页面里直接运行；解释器走本地 SCI，代码不离开浏览器。
sites.desc_en: A twelve-chapter ClojureScript tutorial where every snippet runs in the page on a local Clojure interpreter. Code never leaves the browser.

sites.title: 今天吃什么
sites.desc: 按星期几把你送去该去的地方：周四肯德基、周五麦当劳、周末推会员促销，另有十分之一概率随机挑一家或直接问 AI。灵感来自 v50to.me，附一篇讲路由思路的短文。
sites.desc_en: Routes you somewhere based on the weekday: KFC on Thursday, McDonald's on Friday, membership promos on weekends, and one visit in ten picks at random or asks an AI. Inspired by v50to.me, with a short write-up on why a router is a fun way to kill decision fatigue.
